mapper.sql: ID, DEVICE_CODE, DEVICE_NAME, TOURISM_NAME, FLOW_COUNT, FLOW_DIRECTION, ALG_NAME, TASK_CODE, IMAGE_URL, RECORD_TIME, CREATE_TIME, UPDATE_TIME
mapper.select: SELECT TO_CHAR(RECORD_TIME, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') as time, SUM(FLOW_COUNT) as count FROM CLOUDWALK.FLOW_ANALYSIS WHERE (#{tourismName} IS NULL OR TOURISM_NAME = #{tourismName}) AND (#{deviceCode} IS NULL OR DEVICE_CODE = #{deviceCode}) AND RECORD_TIME BETWEEN #{startTime} AND #{endTime} GROUP BY TO_CHAR(RECORD_TIME, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') ORDER BY time
SELECT FROM CLOUDWALK.FLOW_ANALYSIS WHERE DEVICE_CODE = #{deviceCode} ORDER BY RECORD_TIME DESC FETCH FIRST 1 ROWS ONLY

SELECT SUM(FLOW_COUNT) as totalFlow, AVG(FLOW_COUNT) as avgFlow, MAX(FLOW_COUNT) as maxFlow, MIN(FLOW_COUNT) as minFlow FROM CLOUDWALK.FLOW_ANALYSIS WHERE DEVICE_CODE = #{deviceCode} AND RECORD_TIME BETWEEN #{startTime} AND #{endTime}

SELECT FLOW_DIRECTION as direction, COUNT(*) as count, SUM(FLOW_COUNT) as totalFlow FROM CLOUDWALK.FLOW_ANALYSIS WHERE DEVICE_CODE = #{deviceCode} AND RECORD_TIME BETWEEN #{startTime} AND #{endTime} GROUP BY FLOW_DIRECTION

SELECT EXTRACT(HOUR FROM RECORD_TIME) as hour, SUM(FLOW_COUNT) as totalFlow, AVG(FLOW_COUNT) as avgFlow, MAX(FLOW_COUNT) as maxFlow FROM CLOUDWALK.FLOW_ANALYSIS WHERE DEVICE_CODE = #{deviceCode} AND RECORD_TIME BETWEEN #{startTime} AND #{endTime} GROUP BY EXTRACT(HOUR FROM RECORD_TIME) ORDER BY hour
